impact: A tame CPI would extend the rebound in NBIS, PLTR and memory names; a hot one strengthens December hike odds and hits growth holdings.
summary: Dow futures rose about 0.3% to 0.5% and Nasdaq-100 futures slipped 0.1% to 0.3% early Tuesday ahead of October CPI (consensus +0.3% headline, +0.2% core). Nvidia rose 1.7% premarket after falling more than 4% Monday.
title: US futures mixed before CPI, Nvidia up 1.7% premarket
